model: Every lean the model made on 4 games: 199-116 (63%). By confidence: 70%+ hit 77% of 61, 65-70% hit 81% of 53, 60-65% hit 70% of 56, and under 60% hit 48% of 145.
Picks only come from the 60%+ tiers, so the coin flips that went under 50% never reach the board.

Furthest off among confident leans: Robert Williams III points (projected 6.1, scored 14), Michael Porter Jr. points (projected 18.8, scored 27 in 40 minutes vs 30 projected) and Luka Doncic points (projected 28.8, scored 41).
postgame: Re-run with real minutes, 57 of the 116 losses would have been right, so about half the misses were minutes (MPJ +10, De'Andre Hunter +9) and half production.
Points ran +0.7 per player above projections and rebounds −0.4. Monday leaned the other way, so it's not a skewed input yet. We'll correct it only if it holds for a week.
improving: Refit this morning on every box score; all 5 stat models passed again on 139k unseen player-games.
Team scoring correction applied to today's 12 games: rotations that added up too high from long injury lists were scaled down (PHI x0.90, MIL x0.92) and thin ones scaled up (LAC x1.09, OKC x1.06).
New rule from Monday's coin flips: a pick of the day now needs a 60%+ chance, and a locked pick is withdrawn if the model drops under that or flips sides before tip.
